gloss: to participate; to compete; to enter (a competition)

definitions.gloss: to participate in; to compete in; to enter (a competition, tournament, or event)
definitions.explanation: To take part in a competition, sporting event, contest, or similar organized event as a participant or competitor. Implies formal or official participation rather than casual involvement.

examples.japanese: オリンピックに{出場|しゅつじょう}する。
{今年|ことし}はマラソン{大会|たいかい}に{出場|しゅつじょう}するつもりだ。
examples.english: I plan to enter a marathon this year.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}のため、{次|つぎ}の{試合|しあい}には{出場|しゅつじょう}できないかもしれない。
examples.english: Due to an injury, I might not be able to compete in the next match.

notes:
Composed of {出|しゅつ} (go out) + {場|じょう} (place, arena). Takes the particle に for the event: ～に{出場|しゅつじょう}する. The noun form {出場|しゅつじょう} is also very common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大会|たいかい}に{出場|しゅつじょう}する: to enter a tournament
- {試合|しあい}に{出場|しゅつじょう}する: to compete in a match
- {出場|しゅつじょう}{資格|しかく}: qualification to participate
- {出場|しゅつじょう}{選手|せんしゅ}: participating athlete
- {出場|しゅつじょう}{停止|ていし}: suspension from competition

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {参加|さんか}する: to participate — broader, includes any kind of participation (meetings, events)
- {出場|しゅつじょう}する: specifically for competitions and sporting events
- {出演|しゅつえん}する: to appear, to perform — for shows, TV, stage performances
